cost: CPU-only, cached features; policy cost ratios from E3.04 (x1.94 every-2; x4.86 every-2+4s exit) reported, not re-measured
data_source: caches/gpu/features.json (26 per-pixel features + 2/4/6/8/10s prefixes, 150 IndEgo windows); caches/frames10k/segments.npz (EG2 2fps frame embeddings, 150 windows); caches/ensemble/ensemble_v1.json (frozen hyperparameters/fusion/thresholds); caches/ensemble/ood_scores.json (60 OOD windows, frozen full-window scores)
decision: Integrate the adopted settings into jadal/poc_stream/policy.py (single source of constants) and eval/poc_integrate/run_integration.py; regenerate window verdicts and summary; keep OOD rows descriptive-only. E3.05 status 'working policy on IndEgo, not validated' is quoted verbatim in results and docs.
hypothesis: Applying the adopted settings to the cached scorer path reproduces the adopted view quality at 4s prefixes (EG2 ~0.86, pixel ~0.80, fused >= both) and yields a deterministic per-window accept/reject/uncertain stream with no OOD or accuracy claim.
label_source: human gold (single labeller): 150 IndEgo windows (100 good / 50 bad), labels_sha256 43ab44e5...; human OOD: 60 Egocentric-10K windows (51 good / 9 bad), descriptive only
method: leave-one-clip-out over the 7 IndEgo clips: both logistic views re-fitted per fold at the 4s prefix (frozen ensemble_v1 C_eg2=0.003, C_px=0.3), equal-weight probability fusion, frozen verdict rule (>0.5 accept, <0.4 reject, else uncertain), every-2nd window grid per clip (range(0,n,2)), clip-bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples, seed 7)
regime: CPU only (GPU unavailable in the container); cached features; deterministic (fixed seeds)
summary: n=150 human gold IndEgo windows, LOCO, clip-bootstrap 95% CI. Fused 4s: AUROC 0.874 [0.742,0.942], balanced acc 0.740; EG2 2fps 4s 0.860 [0.715,0.944]; pixel26 4s 0.797 [0.658,0.860]. Full-window comparison: fused 0.849 [0.721,0.929], EG2 0.842, pixel 0.804 (4s not worse; CIs overlap, difference not established). Verdicts over 150 windows: accept 108 / reject 27 / uncertain 15. Every-2nd grid samples 77/150 windows (51.3%). Clip verdicts (sampled bad fraction >= 0.30): 5/7 agree with label-oracle truth (misses desk 0.20 vs 0.45 and pallet2 0.00 vs 0.67, n_sampled=3); E3.01's 7/7 is label-oracle, this is model-based. Cost per E3.04: every-2 x1.94; every-2 + 4s exit x4.86 (~0.907h per 4.404h corpus, 0.2059 of footage). OOD 60 windows (51 good/9 bad) included DESCRIPTIVE ONLY from frozen full-window scores (accept 17 / reject 29 / uncertain 14); no cached features exist to re-score them at 4s and NO OOD/accuracy claim is made.
title: PoC integration: adopted every-2nd window grid + 4s early exit + EG2 2fps + 26-feature pixel logistic (descriptive verdicts)
verdict_scope: ADOPT as the IndEgo working policy in the PoC (E3.05 adopted_policy); NOT validated, no OOD/accuracy claim
why: E3.01/E3.05 adopted an IndEgo working policy (every-2nd window, 4s exit) but the PoC scorer path did not apply it; E1.01/E1.02 views were only measured standalone. This integrates the adopted settings in one policy module and regenerates per-window verdicts from the cached features, with LOCO numbers and DESCRIPTIVE labels only.
